text:
Maya (Onboarding): Kicking off LarkRetail onboarding. Target: pilot in 30 days, handoff at day 42. Need quick list of owners + 2-3 measurable success criteria. Who's in for a 20m sync tomorrow?

Eve (CSM): I can do 10:30am PT. I'll own weekly health check and comms.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): 10:30am PT works. Need infra contact for allowlist/VPC and whether they need private deployment.

Sam - LarkRetail (Customer): 10:30 OK. We'll prefer VPC peering eventually but can start sandbox. I'll share infra POC.

Maya (Onboarding): Draft success criteria: 1) sandbox API E2E, 2) acceptance pass on 5k prompt sample, 3) baseline MAU target for renewals. Additions?

Jon (Renewals): Add "cost-review" watch; customer mentioned a finance check in ~60d. I'll tag renewal_watch.

Noah (Enablement): I'll make a 30-min enablement pack + a short troubleshooting cheat sheet. Recommend training on day 5 post-integration.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I'll bring: API key, model pin (we recommend redwood/opt-13b-quant), sample payloads, small load test. Quick sanity curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"ping"}'
```

Maya (Onboarding): @bot-calendar schedule 20m kickoff tomorrow 13:30 ET / 10:30 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm criteria, infra checklist, owners.

bot-calendar: Event "LarkRetail Onboard Kickoff" scheduled 2026-06-02 13:30 ET. Invitees: Maya, Eve, Ravi, Sam, Noah, Jon.

Sam - LarkRetail (Customer): I'll upload prompts and infra contact before the meeting.

Maya (Onboarding): Action recap: Sam share infra POC + prompts (pre-kickoff); Ravi produce tech checklist (1 day post); Eve draft 30/60/90 plan (3 days); Noah prepare enablement pack (day 5); Jon add renewal_watch in CRM.

Eve (CSM): I'll also set a day-14 pulse to capture early feedback.

Maya (Onboarding): Noted private-deploy risk may add 3 weeks if required early. Sam please confirm by EOD.

Sam - LarkRetail (Customer): Confirming sandbox start, will confirm long-term peering by EOD. See you at kickoff.

Maya (Onboarding): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
